title: Beethoven’s Missing Symphony — public composition log
scope: The part of the composition session that concerns this work, from the user’s request and the claim of the queue entry to the publication step. The same agent session composed other works before and after; those parts are not included. A reviewed public excerpt of saved session history, not a complete internal execution log. Events recorded after the export was made (final verification and the closing report) are not included.
policy: Actual recorded message and tool text is retained where publishable. Private internal reasoning, provider metadata, credentials, access details, private paths, internal IDs, injected instructions, reads of other sessions and oversized dumps are not included. Omission markers and redaction notes identify editorial changes. Statements made during the work may be provisional or mistaken; later corrections remain in the log.
